Value: J_RESET: manual reset through the supervisor MR pin (A-C9)
J_JTAG: TI 14-pin, key pin 6 absent; TCK_RET tied to TCK; pin 4 TDIS to ground
J_BOOT: jumper 1-2 = SCI-A boot, 2-3 or open = flash
J_ESTOP: normally-closed E-stop loop between 3V3 and ESTOP_N
J_NTC: Vishay NTCALUG01A103F heatsink lug NTC (10 k, B 3984 K), SELV lead (CR-01)
J_MEZZ: 2 x 25 header to the power-board SSW-125-01-G-D socket; nets per design_decisions.json interconnect.pin_assignment
